declaredIntent.requestedOutcome: Collect and report anonymized independent reader answers for the English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese P0 routes, bound to the exact documentation revision, without fabricating or overclaiming comprehension.

outOfScope: Recruiting, contacting, or identifying participants from repository code.
Adding names, contact details, or other personal identifying information.
Changing P0 documentation during the study; revision drift invalidates answers.
Claiming general population fluency from a bounded sample.

sources.reason: Raw response shape and anonymization safeguards.

riskAssessment.reason: Participant evidence can be invalid or identifying unless the exact revision, anonymization, raw answers, and review provenance are bound.

reasons: This WI makes a human-comprehension claim and handles participant evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User resumed after the explicit high-risk confirmation request; external readers remain the only authorized answer source.

preReviewWarnings: Do not complete results until the external handoff receipt contains the required anonymized raw answers.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record immutable checkpoints before and after external evidence ingestion.

acceptance: The external handoff binds the study to the exact main revision, protocol, language, and response schema, with an authorized human fulfiller and deadline.
At least one independent nontechnical reader per language route (en, zh-CN, ja) supplies all six raw answers, confidence, consent, and anonymized provenance; missing or invalid answers fail closed.
A results report preserves raw-answer references, per-question scores, limitations, and the explicit sample-size boundary without exposing identifying information.
Focused tests reject revision drift, missing questions, identifying fields, and comprehension-success claims without complete participant evidence; all strict governance checks pass.
guidelines: Only external independent readers may supply participant answers.
Keep exact documentation revision and protocol digest bound to every response.
Remove personal identifying information; preserve raw answer text and reviewer provenance.
Report sample limitations and do not generalize beyond the observed readers.

intent.problem: The packet WI prepared a protocol but no real reader evidence exists; the project understanding bottleneck remains unverified.
constraints: Do not fabricate or infer participant answers.
Do not accept responses from the implementing Agent or project author.
Stop if any required language route or answer is missing.
intent.rationale: The requested end state is that documentation lets nontechnical people understand the project; only independent reader answers can verify that claim.
